name: NOVA-63
intro: NOVA-63 是一个由母语题目构建的多语种多学科基准。权威 EMNLP 论文 PDF 报告 14 种语言、8 个语系、63 个二级学科和 89,107 道选择题；流程包含 LLM 格式抽取与质量标注、抽样人工核验、多模型难度筛选、问答转选择题、跨学科补充及最终平衡。
org: Peking University, Alibaba Group, Zhejiang University
build_method: 母语题目采集, LLM 格式与质量标注, 多模型难度筛选, 补充与人工终审
metric: Accuracy（问题级、二级学科级、一级学科级平均）
task_type: 多项选择, 多学科知识与推理
eval_feature: 母语内容, 63 个学科, 难度控制, 学科均衡
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Multidisciplinary Knowledge and Reasoning
build_method_en: Native-question Collection, LLM Formatting and Quality Annotation, Multi-model Difficulty Screening, Supplementation and Final Human Review
eval_feature_en: Native-language Content, 63 Disciplines, Difficulty Control, Discipline Balance
intro_en: NOVA-63 is a native-question multilingual, multidisciplinary benchmark. The authoritative EMNLP paper PDF reports 89,107 multiple-choice questions across 14 languages, eight language families, and 63 secondary disciplines; construction combines LLM formatting and quality annotation, sample-based human verification, multi-model difficulty screening, QA-to-MCQ and interdisciplinary supplementation, and final balancing.

drawio_review_note: Paper/source audit fixed on 2026-07-18. The primary source is the authoritative ACL Anthology PDF for EMNLP 2025 paper 2025.emnlp-main.364; the reviewed PDF has SHA-256 630e3ad32d57a33b3ff7483befab46a8e68564811df24adbd7716615d5a8df77. Sections 3.1-4.1, Figure 2, Appendices A.1-A.4 and B.1 were checked against the diagram. The PDF body reports 89,107 questions, 14 languages, and eight language families. The body and Appendix D use 13 primary, 63 secondary, and 262 tertiary disciplines, while Figure 2's embedded labels read 13/73/286; the diagram follows the body/appendix 13/63/262 taxonomy and records this internal PDF drift. The ACL landing-page abstract currently says 93,536; ACL states that its PDF is authoritative, so the diagram preserves the PDF total and marks the webpage count as metadata drift. Stage 1 engages native speakers to collect local educational-site, publication, textbook, platform, assessment, and examination questions from secondary-school through postgraduate levels. An LLM performs in-context extraction of question, options, and answer, removes HTML/extraneous content, and simultaneously classifies MCQ versus QA; a sample-based human audit checks multimedia filtering and preservation, extraction completeness, and formatting; it is not a per-item human gate. Stage 2 uses an LLM quality prompt: readability uses 1–3, completeness uses 0–1, clarity/consistency uses 1–3, and only maxima 3/1/3 are retained. Hierarchical metadata classification assigns one of 13 primary, 63 secondary, and 262 tertiary disciplines plus recitation- versus reasoning-based cognitive type. Stage 3 evaluates questions with a disclosed chat/reasoning model panel, dividing small models at at most 14B and large models above 14B; difficulty inference is zero-shot with seed 42 and temperature 0. Questions are retained for difficulty only when large-model accuracy is below 50%. Two suspicious patterns receive special treatment: small-model accuracy above 1.2 times large-model accuracy, or total correctness below 30% while one incorrect option attracts more than 50% of model answers. Native experts with relevant postgraduate expertise check language, ambiguity, missing visual context, and answer correctness. Appendix A.3.2 ultimately discards every small-over-large item beyond the 1.2 threshold and every concentrated-wrong-option item, while other reviewed errors are also rejected; non-suspicious difficult items continue directly. Stage 4 coordinates counts at the secondary-discipline level. It converts 2,425 selected hard QA items into MCQs by judging model answers against gold and using common model errors as distractors; every conversion is re-screened for quality/difficulty and manually reviewed for native fluency and translationese. A complementary branch identifies interdisciplinary questions and assigns them to the smaller applicable pool. Final manual review covers discipline relevance, text quality, machine-translation artifacts, completeness, and obvious logical errors. Each language-secondary-discipline cell keeps at least 50 and at most 150 questions, randomly sampling excess. Evaluation covers 62 LLMs. Chat/reasoning models use zero-shot prompts that require an ending answer, while base models use five-shot option-probability scoring with examples from the same discipline; exact-option accuracy is aggregated by question, secondary discipline, and primary discipline, and main results use the primary-discipline mean. Release boundary: the paper says the dataset is MIT-licensed and freely available, but fixed Hugging Face revision 7bfc98546474aeabddee1f6fdfe1091a28bddbb0 contains only a README that says the dataset is under review and has no data payload. The site therefore labels the currently verifiable release partly public, not fully public. Formal publication evidence [site-a11x-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 2217×1505 (English) and 2195×1505 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 2215×1503 and 2193×1503. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
